title: Suspicious oversized xn-- (punycode) label
description: Tests detection of an oversized, non-standard xn--prefixed subdomain label used as a covert data channel. ACE (xn--) labels are a distinct encoding the hex/base32 detectors do not cover.
notes: A long xn--prefixed label (whether valid IDNA or malformed) is anomalous in a subdomain and a covert channel; a hostname exfil detector should flag oversized/non-decodable ACE labels.
